info.description:
Multi-tenant Identity and Access Management.

This API has two independent Bearer-token systems. Both use the same
`Authorization: Bearer <token>` header, but the tokens are NOT interchangeable:

- **Admin console** (every tag below not prefixed `public-app-`): an HS256 JWT
issued by the admin login flow, scoped via strings like `organizations:read`,
`applications:write`, `super:admin`. Manages organizations, workspaces,
applications, and admin users.

- **Per-application public API** (tags prefixed `public-app-`, routes under
`/public/applications/{id}/...`): an RS256 JWT signed with that *specific
application's own keypair*, scoped via that application's own
`application_user_acl.roles` (e.g. `users:read`, `scopes:write`). A token
minted for one application returns 401 against any other application's
`{id}` — these are end-user tokens for that one app, never admin credentials.

Updates GeoIP enrichment settings, including the MaxMind
account ID and license key. An empty/omitted
maxmind_license_key leaves the currently-stored key unchanged

Changes take effect the next time the geoip-updater process is

post.description:
Launches the geoip-updater executable, detached so it survives
this admin server's own restart. Refuses (409) if an instance

state, so this is accurate even across an admin-server restart.

allow_password_login.description:
AllowPasswordLogin toggles the username+password login endpoint
for this app. Default true preserves legacy behaviour; an admin
flips it off to force the OAuth-only path. Both the login
handler and the public auth-methods endpoint honour this flag.

registration_type.description:
RegistrationType declares how registration is collected:
  - "legacy": consumers render a form with username + password
    implicit and the admin-configured extras on top.
  - "oauth":  provider delivers identity; extras only.
Only "legacy" is wired today; "oauth" is a declarative label
we surface so the consumer can branch its UI ahead of the
provider-flow implementation landing.

geoip_info.description:
GeoIPInfo is a JSON snapshot of the country/ASN/ISP resolved for
IP at the moment this episode opened — frozen then, never
re-derived later (geoip.db keeps no history of its own).
Populated on both the list and the detail fetch. Empty if geoip
was disabled, IP was loopback/private, or nothing matched.

origin_hint.description:

scan_watch_source.description:
ScanWatch* report whether port-scan detection actually has a log
source available on this host — see
plan/port-scan-detection/plan.md Phase B. When
ScanWatchAvailable is false, no port-scan visibility exists at
all (not even the application-layer visibility ip_attacks has),
since there is nothing to ingest.

resource_ids.description:
ResourceIDs is an opaque JSON-encoded array of ids this scope is
constrained to. Defaults to "[]" (unconstrained) when omitted.

scope_id.description:
ScopeID must match acl.ScopeIDFormat: letters/underscores per
segment, separated by colons. Immutable once created.

file_url.description:
FileURL is the absolute serve URL for file-type fields that have a
stored value. Empty for non-file fields and for file fields with no
uploaded file. Populated by PopulateFileURLs after BuildResponse.

value.description:
Value is the user's current value for this field, or null
when the user hasn't filled it in. Type follows DataType:
text → string, number → float64, date → string, select → string, etc.
